descriptionHtml:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

This role is offered as a hybrid in Brno, Czech Republic. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the Czech Republic or who have sponsorship to live and work in the Czech Republic.

What you'll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. You'll be joining team Red, the team behind Compliance Benchmarks. The team owns the services that turn published security baselines into benchmarks, check what Apple devices are actually doing against them, and produce the compliance reports our customers rely on. Our work is used by organizations in some of the most regulated industries in the world. We build with AI coding agents as a core part of how we work, and we want someone who will push us further. As the Software Engineer II, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the team's Java microservices, develop a depth of knowledge around designated area of the product and collaborate with other engineers, product management and leadership to understand your team's priorities and how those help us solve company-wide problems.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Build and evolve backend microservices (Java, Spring Boot, Pulsar, MongoDB) running on Kubernetes in AWS.
  • Work across the services that generate benchmarks, keep them in sync with upstream security baselines, and turn results into customer-facing reports.
  • Break down customer problems into work you and the team can execute on.
  • Independently complete a majority of identified tasks from start to finish with high quality.
  • Direct AI coding agents as a core part of your daily workflow, and own the result: specify the work, review what comes back and verify it before it ships.
  • Use your knowledge of Engineering best practices to ask the right questions, solve problems and build great software.
  • Clearly communicate technical concepts with others in the organization (primarily technical communication).

What we are looking for:

  • 3+ years building enterprise-grade software with solid testing and QA practices.
  • 3+ years hands-on with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience with backend microservices in a cloud environment (AWS/Kubernetes is a plus).
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Pulsar or similar) and document databases (MongoDB or similar) is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) on real projects, with a workflow of your own and a clear sense of where agents go wrong.
  • Comfortable working in agile teams with modern SDLC practices.
  • A collaborative, solution-oriented mindset - you build trust across teams and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in security, compliance or regulated environments is welcome, but we do not expect you to arrive knowing our domain.
  • Fluency in Czech/Slovak.

Why Jamf?

  • We are progressive but laid back. You are free to be yourself and work how you work best. Here, you manage your own day and your own work style.
  • You will have the opportunity to work with a small and empowered team where the culture is based on trust, ownership, and respect.
  • With hybrid and remote roles, we offer an open flexible culture based on respect and trust.
  • Benefits are a critical part of the “whole employee experience”. Our benefits package includes 30 days of paid time off, 3 paid days to volunteer, Benefit Plus cafeteria, Multisport Card, and more.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Visit our Jamf Engineering blog to learn more about the innovative projects our team is working on and what we learn from each challenge we solve. A blog written by engineers, for engineers at medium.com/jamf-engineering

What it means to be a Jamf?

We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?

Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at [removed]

descriptionHtml:
If you want to build and own the systems that decide what JetBrains customers are entitled to use and bill them accurately for it, this is for you. You will focus on designing backend services, keeping complex commercial flows correct, and tackling hard distributed systems challenges on the critical path of every paid request.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What You’ll Do

At JetBrains, the Cloud Platform department builds the underlying infrastructure that powers authentication, paid capabilities, usage metering, and accounting. Within this department, the Licensing & Billing team sits right at the center of our commercial model, turning what a customer buys into what they are actually allowed to use, and accounting for that consumption accurately enough to bill on.

The complexity of our entitlement, quota, and metering systems continues to grow. In this role, you will own the correctness and evolution of these backend services, take full ownership of end-to-end data flows, tackle distributed consistency across unreliable upstream systems, and ensure revenue-affecting data migrations happen cleanly without taking services offline.

Day To Day, You Will

  • Design, build, and operate backend services that decide what a customer is entitled to and what their usage costs.
  • Own flows end to end, from ingesting licensing and purchase data from upstream systems to enforcing quotas and recording consumption.
  • Evolve our domain model to handle new commercial structures, combining seat-based plans and usage-based models.
  • Design integrations with external systems, ensuring correctness through idempotency, ordering, reconciliation, and eventual consistency.
  • Plan and execute live data migrations using feature flags, dual writes, backfills, and verification at every stage.
  • Build observability into our systems by defining invariants, metrics, and alerts to catch silent divergence before customers do.
  • Design internal APIs with explicit focus on versioning, backward compatibility, and developer experience for other JetBrains teams.
  • Improve system performance and reliability under continuous production load while decommissioning legacy subsystems.
  • Write integration tests against real dependencies and maintain reliable test infrastructure.
  • Investigate production incidents, find root causes, and follow through on lasting fixes.

What You’ll Bring

  • An engineer’s dedication to accuracy, especially in domains where system errors have direct financial impact.
  • Pragmatic judgment when designing distributed systems where correctness under unreliable delivery is the main constraint.
  • A habit of trusting metrics, traces, and logs to understand production behavior rather than relying on assumptions.
  • Comfort navigating and simplifying large existing codebases containing legacy decisions.
  • Clear, direct communication skills to agree on API contracts across teams with different priorities.
  • A focus on testing as an essential design tool rather than an afterthought.

What You’ll Need

  • A proven track record of building and operating backend services on the JVM platform using Kotlin or Java.
  • A solid working knowledge of relational databases, including transactions, isolation levels, locking, indexing, and live schema migrations (PostgreSQL preferred).
  • A deep understanding of distributed systems patterns, such as idempotency, retry strategies, eventual consistency, and data reconciliation.
  • Practical experience making live data migrations or system changes without downtime using feature flags and staged rollouts.
  • Experience designing versioned, backward-compatible APIs for other engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers like Kafka.
  • The ability to diagnose, debug, and resolve production incidents in complex environments.
  • Proficiency in both written and spoken English.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building a bulletproof entitlement and metering foundation that product teams can trust without hesitation. You will have successfully migrated live commercial systems to support new billing models without downtime or data divergence. Silent errors will be caught automatically by system invariants before affecting users, and internal teams will integrate seamlessly with your clean, versioned APIs.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. (keep if relevant for the role)
  • Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
  • Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
  • Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
  • Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
  • Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.
  • Some benefits may vary depending on location.

We are an equal opportunity employer

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.
